title: Tại sao pin sụt nhanh khi trời lạnh? Năng lượng biến đi đâu? | Văn phòng Ra Là Vậy
description:
Mùa đông, lấy điện thoại ra ngoài vài phút là sập nguồn, xe điện tụt pin thảm hại. Nhưng khi mang vào phòng ấm cắm sạc, pin tự nhảy vọt trở lại! Năng lượng đã đi đâu? Nếu tụt pin chỉ là tạm thời, tại sao chuyên gia cảnh báo tuyệt đối không sạc nhanh lúc trời lạnh?

Viện trưởng và Bé Hỏi bóc tách sự thật vi mô của pin lithium-ion dưới độ âm: từ rào cản khử dung môi, điện trở màng SEI tăng vọt 34 lần, cho đến hiện tượng mạ lithium kim loại và tái thâm nhập tự phát!

Hình ảnh minh họa tạo bởi AI. Mọi dữ liệu khoa học được đối chiếu từ các bài báo bình duyệt quốc tế.

Thông tin tính đến 2026-11-17.

p043.text: Excess fluorine builds thick crusts, wiping out voltage plateaus;

p046.text: Discharge stalls are temporary; warming brings it back.

p047.text: Why do experts warn strictly against winter fast charging?

p048.text: Charging in cold causes permanent damage!

p050.text: graphite capacity before zero volts drops,

p052.text: to 160 at minus 30, and just 106 at minus 40!

p053.text: Channels freeze while currents cram electrons.

p054.text: Blocked lithium ions grab electrons on the graphite surface, turning into metallic lithium!

p056.text: even without overcharging, at 0.05 to 0.1 volts,

p057.text: metallic lithium grows in microscopic nooks,

p058.text: and by the second cycle, a quarter turns into dead lithium!

p059.text: Karlsruhe Institute cycled 25 Ah cells 500 times at minus 10,

p060.text: permanently losing a quarter of capacity,

p061.text: swelling up after two days resting,

p062.text: emitting 32.61 phần trăm hydrogen and 25.79 phần trăm carbon monoxide!

p063.text: Opening the anode revealed 1 to 5 nanometer black metallic lithium spots.

p064.text: Metallic lithium piercing separators brings catastrophic thermal runaway!

p065.text: Is there really no cure for this?

p066.text: Remarkably, plated surface lithium can re-enter on its own!

p069.text: lithium-staged graphite phases continue to increase!

p070.text: At 0.75C, this relaxation takes 9.2 minutes at minus 10,

p071.text: 45.1 minutes at minus 18, and 61.7 minutes at minus 23 độ!

p072.text: UC Berkeley saw it under microscopy:

p073.text: during the first 1.5 hours after charging, golden lithiated phases keep marching inward!

p074.text: Pausing for three minutes at 45 phần trăm state of charge,

p075.text: delayed the plating onset by five phần trăm;

p076.text: resting too early at 28 phần trăm or too late at 52.5 phần trăm had zero effect.

p077.text: Braking right when ions are choked,

p079.text: Yet vehicle battery packs are sealed tight;

p080.text: without opening cells, how can we detect plating?

p081.text: Scientists developed three tactics. First: ultrasounds!

p082.text: RWTH Aachen scanned with 25 MHz ultrasound every 56 seconds:

p083.text: as voltage reaches 4V, plated regions flare into bright white spots;

p084.text: resting for ten minutes, white spots visibly shrink and vanish!

p085.text: Second tactic needs no sensors, tracking voltage curves!

p086.text: TU Graz tested automotive 64.6 Ah pouch cells:

p087.text: when plated lithium re-enters, voltage forms a distinct flat plateau!

p089.text: yet at zero độ, a 3C charge plated less lithium than 2C!

p090.text: Severe 3C polarization quickly hit voltage cutoffs,

p091.text: chỉ sạc 34,3 Ah; sạc ít mạ ít hơn.

p092.text: Third tactic measures expansion force directly!

p093.text: Plated lithium takes over four times the volume of intercalated lithium!

p094.text: Tongji University found normal expansion force is 590 Newtons,

p095.text: surging to 1230 Newtons the instant plating begins!

p096.text: Sensing the stress surge, the system cuts charging rate to 0.5C,

p097.text: stress drops, achieving 100 cycles with zero lithium plating!

p098.text: From ultrasound and voltage plateaus to mechanical force,

p100.text: If cold causes plating, but permanent thermal insulation wears cells out in summer,

p101.text: accelerating degradation, how can we solve this dilemma?

p102.text: UC Berkeley engineered a counter-intuitive thermal switch!

p103.text: During driving, it presses against heatsinks, maintaining an optimal 30 độ.

p104.text: Khi sạc nhanh, dây nitinol đẩy cell 0,5 mm,

p106.text: raising surface temperature to 42.2 độ in minutes,

p107.text: slashing desolvation barrier, letting ions enter lattices!

p108.text: The second it hits 80 phần trăm, the switch reconnects to cool down!

p109.text: A 5 Ah cell charged at 6C to 80 phần trăm in 15 minutes,

p110.text: surviving 975 cycles, far outlasting the 665 cycles of permanently insulated cells!

p111.text: Retain own heat when needed; dump heat immediately when done!

p112.text: This links our opening insulation and self-heating!

p113.text: Don't panic if your phone dies in winter; charge is just outside.

p114.text: Give it time to warm up indoors, and never rush to plug in ultra-fast charging!
